Three (3) years of financial operations experience, directly related to BMT and Cellular Therapy.

items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.

Nine (9) years of related experience, education/training, OR a bachelor’s degree in a related area plus five (5) years of related experience/training. Related experience: insurance, billing, finance, fiscal management, administration, clinical trials, regulatory compliance, and financial analysis.
Three (3) years of financial operations experience, directly related to BMT and Cellular Therapy.
Experience with financial management and reimbursement analysis for high-cost oncology, transplant, cellular therapy, or other advanced therapies.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing targeted financial and operational improvement plans to enhance fiscal performance, revenue integrity, and operational effectiveness.
Demonstrated experience obtaining and negotiating single-case agreements (SCAs) and letters of agreement (LOAs) to secure appropriate reimbursement for complex, high-cost medical treatments.

Demonstrated experience interpreting complex healthcare financial models, including payer-specific reimbursement, direct and indirect costs, financial forecasting, and margin analysis to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Experience evaluating financial risk related to high-cost drugs, including payer authorization, contract interpretation, reimbursement verification, and financial clearance.
Demonstrated experience interpreting healthcare payer contracts, identifying financial exposure, and resolving revenue integrity concerns associated with complex medical services.
Advanced financial modeling experience, including direct and indirect costs, payer-specific reimbursement, and margin analysis.
Demonstrated leadership experience, including staff supervision, human resources management, employee development, training, and performance management.
Experience with complex reimbursement issues, revenue integrity, and payer contract compliance.
Prior supervisory experience required, including demonstrated ability to screen applications, interview candidates, and either make selection decisions or recommend individuals for hire.
Experience collaborating with clinical teams, pharmacy, contracting, and revenue cycle leadership.
Experience and proven success in finance policies, practices and systems, budgeting and reporting techniques, accounting and bookkeeping.
Experience with County, State, and Federal Government-sponsored healthcare programs and associated reimbursement and compliance requirements.

The Financial Supervisor provides specialized financial oversight for the UCSD BMT & Cellular therapy division, Stem Cell Laboratory, Registry Acquisition, Transplant and Cellular Therapy services, encompassing more than $390 million in annual billing.

The position is responsible for financial planning, analysis, reporting, and strategic business support to ensure financial performance, revenue integrity, contract compliance, and operational efficiency across all transplant, cellular therapy, and related service lines.
Financial Management & Reporting: Develops and oversees financial and operational reporting to support business performance measurement, strategic planning, budgeting, and financial decision-making.

Financial Analysis & Modeling: Performs complex cost analyses, new therapy financial modeling, budget development, and reimbursement evaluations. Identifies adverse financial trends and provides recommendations to improve financial performance.

Contract Management & Reimbursement: Monitors all transplant, BMT, Stem Cell, and Cellular Therapy cases for contract compliance, accurate billing, and appropriate reimbursement. Identifies reimbursement variances and works to ensure expected revenue is received.
Revenue Reporting & Audits: Initiates, develops, and produces monthly revenue reports to UCSD Leadership for Transplant and Cellular Therapy.

Pricing & Contract Negotiations: Develops comprehensive pricing proposals and financial packages for BMT, Cellular Therapy, and ancillary or related service lines to support contract negotiations and business development.

Financial Planning & Business Strategy: Provides in-depth financial analysis and recommendations to support new program development, service line expansion, business planning, and financial sustainability.

Staff Leadership & Development: Supervises the Finance Team, providing leadership, education, training, mentoring, and professional development while overseeing billing processes, coding accuracy, compliance, and operational process improvements.
Ability to interpret complex financial data, identify trends, develop recommendations, and communicate financial results to executive leadership and operational stakeholders.
Advanced Excel and healthcare financial reporting skills.
Comprehensive knowledge of healthcare insurance products and reimbursement methodologies, including HMO, PPO, and POS plans.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, problem-solving, and strategic planning skills.
